purpose: Sequence completion and expansion by the uncertainty most likely to change interpretation, not by subject prominence or dataset size.

triage_method.law: Prefer work that closes a denominator, retrieves a decisive instrument, or creates a same-system control before broadening to additional subjects.
triage_method.boundary: These categories organize research operations. They are not scores, allegations, or judgments about any person or organization.

first_ten_after_closure.why_now: Designation and development anchors were already bounded; the remaining test depends on parcel chronology, fund identity, and value baselines.
The board authorization is known; the executed agreement, land custody, and full same-agency site denominator determine whether the pattern is ordinary joint development.
The final federal award is known; local infrastructure, title, incentive terms, and milestone outlays determine the actual public-risk sequence.
The topline funding split is known; the lease, non-relocation, title, cash-flow, and ancillary-rights instruments decide who bears and captures risk.
The legislation and datasets exist; the decisive fog is the row-level join among boundary, projects, fund flows, ownership, and the executed agreement.
The leadership denominator is bounded; the investigation turns on filer identity, disclosed legal entities, and exact award or capital-vehicle joins.
The only open first-cohort denominator can now be closed, unlocking legally resolved company, founder, capital, and government-market joins.
The initial roster is bounded; ethics custody, tenure, post-government roles, and regulated-surface joins determine whether apparent crossings are real.
The 100-member denominator is complete; all evidentiary value now lies in lawful report acquisition, legal-entity resolution, award joins, temporal order, and explicit nulls.
The 45-authority denominator and transaction datasets are known; the remaining uncertainty is row extraction, officeholder disclosures, exact entities, and temporal null-preserving joins.

fog_that_reveals_most.reveals: Whether apparent recurrence survives full cohort accounting and explicit nulls.
fog_that_reveals_most.next_action: Close bounded rosters before any person, capital, or award recurrence claim.

fog_that_reveals_most.reveals: Who bears risk, who controls land or substitution, and what happens on default or nonperformance.
current_pressure_points: TSMC and Micron incentive and infrastructure instruments
fog_that_reveals_most.next_action: Acquire signed instruments and clause-level obligation tables before interpreting topline announcements.

fog_that_reveals_most.reveals: Whether the same legal entity or person actually crosses the public decision and money surfaces, and in what temporal order.
current_pressure_points: NY/California authority vendors and land counterparties
fog_that_reveals_most.next_action: Resolve legal identities independently, freeze both denominators, run exact joins, and retain nulls.

next_ten_work_order.why_now: The 2026 denominator is now complete; the prior-year roster immediately reveals recurrence, attrition, and a 72-versus-74 official count discrepancy.
Same-agency authorization and document architecture is the cleanest control for District NoHo.
The 78 holds city, council date, and TIF data systems constant against Cortland/Chicago River.
A second chamber tests whether disclosure crossings survive a much larger denominator and different portal.
A ten-person tenure-complete cohort makes ethics, role, and calendar fog tractable.
A four-person leadership denominator and explicit federal portfolio expose the capital-to-government decision seam.
A second final CHIPS award with a completed ROD separates federal program structure from Arizona-specific conditions.
The venue and public development district are documented separately, revealing who holds ancillary land and infrastructure rights.
Multiple local instruments test whether the formation pattern exists before an exact Opportunity Zone tract join.
Dense board, procurement, property, and disclosure surfaces can expose state-level contract and land crossings with explicit decision windows.

boundaries: Operational position is not a merit, suspicion, influence, or publication ranking.
The highest-value fog is the unknown most capable of changing interpretation.
Same-system and longitudinal controls are preferred because they reduce confounding before expansion.
